turn_text: I have to say that during the entire process, everything is very family-friendly, which for me and many of the new members who are coming in that have young families, that aspect is very helpful. It was one of the most special things I had done in my life was to be able to have my two young children sitting with me on the house floor when I was sworn in.

explicit_propositions.text: The entire process is very family-friendly.
Having my two young children present during my swearing-in ceremony was one of the most special experiences of my life.
Family-friendliness in the process is helpful to me and other new members with young families.
Many new members have young families.

assumptions.text: Being able to bring children to official ceremonies enhances personal significance and emotional value.
A supportive environment for parents is important for attracting and retaining new members with young families.
The presence of children at formal events like oaths of office is socially acceptable and appropriate.
New members with young families prioritize work environments that accommodate their parental responsibilities.
Personal emotional experiences involving children contribute significantly to perceived life meaning.
